definitions.gloss: good quality, high quality, fine quality
definitions.explanation: Of superior quality. Used to describe materials, products, content, or services that are of a high standard. Functions both as a noun and as a modifier with な or の.

examples.japanese: {良質|りょうしつ}な{睡眠|すいみん}をとりたい。
examples.english: I want to get good quality sleep.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{良質|りょうしつ}な{水|みず}に{恵|めぐ}まれている。
examples.english: This area is blessed with high-quality water.

examples.japanese: {良質|りょうしつ}のたんぱく{質|しつ}を{含|ふく}む{食品|しょくひん}を{意識的|いしきてき}に{選|えら}んでいる。
examples.english: I consciously choose foods that contain high-quality protein.

notes:
USAGE:
Can be used with either な or の as a modifier: {良質|りょうしつ}な{素材|そざい} or {良質|りょうしつ}の{素材|そざい} (high-quality material). Both are natural, though な is slightly more common.

The opposite is {粗悪|そあく} (inferior quality) or {低品質|ていひんしつ} (low quality). Compared to {高品質|こうひんしつ} (high-quality), {良質|りょうしつ} sounds slightly warmer and less technical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良質|りょうしつ}な{睡眠|すいみん}: quality sleep
- {良質|りょうしつ}な{素材|そざい}: high-quality materials
- {良質|りょうしつ}なコンテンツ: quality content
- {良質|りょうしつ}のたんぱく{質|しつ}: high-quality protein
